item.title: Malaysia: Driving Next-Generation Digital Health Reform
item.description: Malaysia is entering the implementation phase of a broad health reform agenda, leveraging digital systems, financing, workforce and public health initiatives to modernise, coordinate and strengthen its healthcare system.

item.title: Western Australia Funds Smart Clean Energy Innovation
item.description: The Western Australian Government has launched a new funding round of up to AU$9 million to accelerate scalable, innovative clean energy technologies supporting decarbonisation, energy resilience and regional development.

item.title: Vietnam: National Plan to Digitise Civil Status Records by 2030
item.description: Vietnam has approved a 2026–2030 national action plan to fully digitise civil status registration, ensuring accurate, timely electronic records and improved access to legal identity nationwide for all citizens.

item.title: Hong Kong: Expanding Government Digital Infrastructure
item.description: Hong Kong has launched a new government IT tender to expand project scale, enhance technology adoption, strengthen cybersecurity and broaden SME participation in public sector digital transformation.

item.title: New Zealand: Strengthening Digital Health Systems Resilience
item.description: New Zealand is strengthening the security and resilience of its digital health systems following the ManageMyHealth cyber incident, ensuring patient data protection and coordinated response for the future.

item.title: Malaysia: Digital Economy Surges on AI-Led Growth
item.description: Malaysia’s digital economy hit RM6.8 billion in exports between 2024 and mid-2025, driven largely by AI and advanced digital solutions, expanding into 39 global markets and strengthening Malaysia’s international tech presence.

item.title: Australia: Fully Integrated Digital Licensing in Queensland
item.description: Queensland expands its Digital Licence app to include trainer accreditations, improving verification, streamlining licence management and supporting wider adoption of secure digital identity services.

item.title: Vietnam: Hanoi’s Digitally-Enabled, People-Centred Health System
item.description: Hanoi is modernising its healthcare system by expanding digital health records, cashless services and 24/7 emergency care to improve overall efficiency, patient access and patient-focused care delivery.

item.title: Hong Kong: HKUST Leads in AI, Energy and Infrastructure Research
item.description: HKUST leads funding round with projects advancing AI, resilient infrastructure, low-altitude systems and clean energy while accelerating translational research impact.

item.title: The Philippines: Butuan City Accelerating Digital Public Services
item.description: Butuan City is modernising government services by deploying digital platforms and tech-enabled systems, streamlining business permits and civil registry processes for faster, more efficient and citizen-centric access.
